items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: We were at Sibley’s audition — this was for the big Mickey Mouse Club contest, and Steve won because he could tap dance and play drums. I’ll never forgive him for that.

ctx.x: Yeah they would come in and do a 60-second spot and whatever, get a union wage for that?
Yeah they’d do three a day. Steve Gadd was doing double scale, three a day. I mean I think he had checks at the union he never bothered to pick up. Have you interviewed Steve at all?
I’ve tried to get with him. But maybe I need a phone number from somebody. He came a long way from the Ted Mack Amateur Hour.
